Problem.description: An RFC 9457 problem document. This is the entry point's default error shape, which a host-supplied ErrorResponder may replace.

detail.description: A longer explanation of this occurrence, present only when the answering module has one to give. It may be a sentence rendered in the request language or a language-neutral token such as "forbidden", so clients must not parse it.

instance.description: A URI identifying this occurrence; absent when there is none to give.

status.description: The HTTP status code the response is written with, repeated from the status line.

title.description: A short summary of the kind of problem. A module that sets none gets the standard English status text for the status code.

type.description: The machine-readable code identifying the kind of problem. A module that sets none gets the RFC 9457 default about:blank; codes this platform defines are URNs of the form urn:speed:<capability>:<code>.

account.description: The account identifier of the active member that becomes the organization's owner.

delete.description: Deletes one organization, called by the organization's current owner. The tenant surface decides by owner identity: the acting account must be the row's OwnerAccount, and no platform permission is asked. The write is a tombstone: the identifier and the alias stay and are never reusable, and the organization's memberships, bindings, roles and grants are removed in the same transaction, under the same tenant lock the platform surface takes. A protected tenant is refused by the host's write guard. A mandatory audit row lands before the write; if it cannot, nothing is written and the request is answered 503. A tombstone is a 409: deletion is terminal.

parameters.description: The tenant's identifier, the natural key the roster keys a tenant by: non-empty and free of whitespace and control characters.
parameters.name: tenant

400.description: The identifier is outside the identifier domain

403.description: The caller is not the organization's owner, the caller has not proved an email address (contact-required), or the tenant is protected (urn:speed:tenant:protected)

404.description: No tenant carries the identifier, or the path tenant is not the tenant the request resolved to or is the platform domain

409.description: The tenant is a tombstone, or the caller stopped owning the organization before the write committed

put.description: Hands one organization's ownership on, called by the organization's current owner. The tenant surface decides by owner identity: the acting account must be the row's OwnerAccount, and no platform permission is asked. The target must be an active member of the organization whose account is active; the transfer grants it tenant-admin if it does not hold it, and the previous owner loses every binding in the organization and is removed from it. The transfer and those writes are one transaction, under the tenant lock the platform surface takes too. A mandatory audit row lands before the write; if it cannot, nothing is written and the request is answered 503.

parameters.description: The organization's identifier as the request surface addresses it. The path-tenant layer holds it to the tenant the request resolved to before the handler runs, and the platform domain is refused.
parameters.name: tenant

requestBody.description: The account identifier of the active member that becomes the owner.

400.description: The identifier is outside the identifier domain, the request body is not one JSON object, or the account member is absent

403.description: The caller is not the organization's owner, or the caller has not proved an email address (contact-required)

404.description: No tenant carries the identifier, or the path tenant is not the tenant the request resolved to or is the platform domain

409.description: The target is not an active member, the target's account is not active, or the tenant is a tombstone

413.description: The request body is over the endpoint's limit

put.summary: Transfer the caller's organization to another member
